column1: # Models that build.sh can download (bash build.sh --list-models).
# One model per line, fields separated by TABs:
#   id  file  bytes  sha256  status  ram_gb  url  description
# - id: the name passed to --download-model=ID (lower case, digits, '.', '-').
# - file: the name it gets in models/ (no folders).
# - bytes, sha256: the exact file; a download that does not match is never put in place.
# - status: validated (checked against a reference: tokenizer, perplexity, chat template)
#   or experimental (loads and runs, not checked yet; downloaded only when named).
# - ram_gb: RAM for comfortable use (larger models also run from disk, more slowly).
# - url: https, pinned to a repository revision, so the bytes cannot change under the same name.
# The first validated line is the default of a plain --download-model.
# A line with the id ID.mmproj is the projector of model ID (after it) and comes along with it.

column8: LFM2.5 24B MoE (2B active): the reference model
LFM2.5 8B MoE (1.5B active): fast on the CPU, fits in 8 GB
LFM3-Audio 2B: hears and speaks (transcription, translation, speech, voice chat)
